DocumentationNarrative.Body:
`MetaDataWarehouse` describes a dimensional warehouse independently of its physical SQL names. Dimensions, attributes, business keys, facts, measures, grain, roles, snapshots, and slowly changing behavior belong to the warehouse design.
Implementation workspaces carry physical names, keys, platform columns, defaults, and indexes. This keeps the warehouse intent readable while leaving deployment details explicit.
DocumentationNarrative.Title: Working with MetaDataWarehouse

DocumentationNarrative.Body: Author dimensional warehouse models and implementation policies that project to deployable SQL workspaces.
